META_DESCRIPTION: FincWin backs up your finance data to your own Google Drive — encrypted, restorable on any device, with no copy kept on our servers. Free to start.
OG_DESCRIPTION: Encrypted backup to your own Google Drive. Restore on any device. FincWin keeps no copy. Free.
FEATURE_SUBHEAD: Back up everything to a Drive file you own and control. Restore on any device. FincWin never keeps a copy.
PROBLEM_HEADLINE: Local-first is private — until you lose the device
PROBLEM_BODY:
Keeping data in your browser is private, but it also means a lost phone or cleared cache can take your budget with it. Most apps solve this by storing your data on their servers — trading privacy for safety.

FincWin refuses the trade. Your backup goes to your own Google Drive, encrypted, and you can restore it anywhere.
HOW_IT_WORKS:
• Connect Google Drive — authorise once; FincWin only touches its own backup file.
  • Back up — your data is encrypted and saved to your Drive.
  • Switch devices — open FincWin anywhere and restore from Drive.
  • Stay in control — the file is yours; delete it any time.
CAPABILITIES:
• ✓Encrypted backup to your own Drive.
  • ✓Restore anywhere — move between phone and desktop.
  • ✓No server storage — FincWin keeps no copy of your data.
  • ✓You own the file — full control, delete any time.
  • ✓Scoped access — FincWin only sees its own backup file.
  • ✓Works with offline-first — back up when it suits you.
